# ModelScript

> Open-core computable digital thread for polyglot engineering and simulation. Imports 168 simulation and CAE formats, links them to requirements, solves DAEs/ODEs via a WebAssembly linear-memory arena, coordinates cross-domain co-simulation, and exports FMI 2.0/3.0 FMUs.

## Quick Links
- [Official Website](https://modelscript.org/)
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/modelscript/modelscript)
- [Pricing & Commercial Licensing](https://modelscript.org/pricing): Open-Core (AGPLv3 Community Edition), Enterprise Intranet Appliance (`ee/`), and Commercial OEM SDK licensing.
- [Trademark Policy](https://modelscript.org/trademark): Official trademark and brand usage guidelines for ModelScript and Ansatz.
- [Full Documentation (Single File)](https://modelscript.org/llms-full.txt)

## Guides & Learning

- [Getting Started](https://modelscript.org/guide/getting-started): First steps, project scaffolding, and simulation execution.
- [AI Agents & MCP Workflows](https://modelscript.org/guide/ai-agents): Closed-loop AI engineering workflows and Model Context Protocol setup.
- [CI/CD & GitHub Actions](https://modelscript.org/guide/ci-cd): Automated linting, formal verification, and SARIF code scanning.
- [Embedding ModelScript](https://modelscript.org/guide/embedding): Headless programmatic usage in Node.js, browsers, and WebAssembly.
- [Administration](https://modelscript.org/guide/administration): Enterprise deployment, licensing, and security disclosures.

- [ActivityPub Federation](https://modelscript.org/ansatz/federation): W3C ActivityPub S2S federation, WebFinger, and peer verification.
- [Package Registry](https://modelscript.org/ansatz/package-registry): Content-addressable package registry with Ed25519 signatures and multi-lens manifests.
- [Cloud HPC Simulation](https://modelscript.org/ansatz/cloud-hpc): Slurm HPC offload, WebGPU batched sweeps, and compute credit billing.
- [Self-Hosting Guide](https://modelscript.org/ansatz/self-hosting): Docker Compose deployment profiles, Cloudflare Zero Trust tunnels, and hot SQLite backups.

## Compiler Architecture & WebAssembly Runtime
- [Architecture Overview](https://modelscript.org/architecture/overview): Salsa memoization, WASM linear memory DAE arena, and lowering pipeline.
- [Monorepo & Taxonomy](https://modelscript.org/architecture/monorepo): Workspace organization, package boundaries, and dependency taxonomy.
- [DAE Arena](https://modelscript.org/architecture/dae-arena): Struct-of-arrays linear memory DAE container for zero-overhead symbolic transformations.
- [GLR Parser](https://modelscript.org/architecture/glr-parser): High-performance native WebAssembly generalized LR parser generator.
- [Salsa Query Engine](https://modelscript.org/architecture/salsa-queries): Incremental memoization, dependency tracking, and Salsa cache backdating.
- [Simulation Solvers](https://modelscript.org/architecture/simulation-solvers): SUNDIALS CVODE/IDA, BDF, Runge-Kutta, and WebGPU batched solver.
- [Triple Graph Grammars](https://modelscript.org/architecture/tgg): Bidirectional schema synchronization and multi-language transformation.
- [Theory Coordinator](https://modelscript.org/architecture/theory-coordinator): Cross-domain physical theory unification and ontology coordination.
- [HIL & WASM Runtime](https://modelscript.org/architecture/hil-wasm-runtime): Hardware-in-the-loop and headless WebAssembly execution.

## Algorithms & Solvers Catalog
- [Algorithms Catalog Overview](https://modelscript.org/algorithms/overview): Catalog of 16 symbolic and numerical algorithms.
- [BLT Partitioning](https://modelscript.org/algorithms/blt): Block Lower Triangular decomposition, bipartite matching, and Tarjan SCC.
- [Pantelides Index Reduction](https://modelscript.org/algorithms/pantelides): Structural index reduction for high-index DAEs to index-1 form.
- [Algebraic Loop Tearing](https://modelscript.org/algorithms/tearing): Cellier tearing and minimal residual selection for nonlinear systems.
- [Numerical Solvers (ODE/DAE)](https://modelscript.org/algorithms/solvers-ode-dae): Adaptive step-size numerical integrators and stiff solvers.
- [Automatic Differentiation](https://modelscript.org/algorithms/autodiff): Forward and reverse mode algorithmic differentiation on arena expressions.
- [Optimization & Optimal Control](https://modelscript.org/algorithms/optimization): Collocation, parameter estimation, and nonlinear programming.
- [Surrogates & Linear Algebra](https://modelscript.org/algorithms/surrogates-linear-algebra): Dynamic mode decomposition, POD, and neural surrogates.
- [Connector Balancing](https://modelscript.org/algorithms/connector-balancing): Kirchhoff current law and flow variable balance equations.
- [Physical Theory Coordination](https://modelscript.org/algorithms/theory-coordinator): Multi-physics conservation laws and constitutive relations.
- [Graph Rewriting & E-Graphs](https://modelscript.org/algorithms/graph-rewriting): E-graph rewriting and term normalization.
- [Formal Verification & CHC](https://modelscript.org/algorithms/verification-chc): Constrained Horn Clauses and formal contract verification.
- [Abstract Interpretation](https://modelscript.org/algorithms/abstract-interpretation): Interval arithmetic and sign domain safety analysis.
- [SDP & BVP for CAD](https://modelscript.org/algorithms/sdp-bvp-cad): Boundary value problem solving on CSG and boundary representation geometry.
- [Diagram Layout](https://modelscript.org/algorithms/diagram-layout): Orthogonal routing and hierarchical port placement.
- [Linear Memory Structures](https://modelscript.org/algorithms/linear-memory-structures): Zero-allocation arena buffers and offset-based pointers.

## Polyglot Languages (168 Formats)
- [Polyglot Overview & Capability Matrix](https://modelscript.org/languages/overview): Cross-language capability matrix across all 168 formats.
- [Modelica (.mo) [beta]](https://modelscript.org/languages/modelica): Acausal multi-domain physics.
- [AMPL (.mod, .dat, .run, .nl, .mps) [beta]](https://modelscript.org/languages/ampl): Mathematical programming & optimization (LP, MILP, NLP).
- [SysML v2 / KerML (.sysml) [beta]](https://modelscript.org/languages/sysml2): Systems architecture & requirements.
- [ReqIF (.reqif) [beta]](https://modelscript.org/languages/reqif): Requirements interchange & contract entailment.
- [MagicDraw / Cameo (.mdzip) [beta]](https://modelscript.org/languages/magicdraw): SysML 1.x / UML 2.x archive inspection, diagrams & SysML v2 migration.
- [NIST OSCAL (.oscal.json) [alpha]](https://modelscript.org/languages/oscal): Cyber-physical security controls & SP 800-53 assessment.
- [SSP (.ssp) [beta]](https://modelscript.org/languages/ssp): FMU system structure & parameterization.
- [OWL2 (.owl) [beta]](https://modelscript.org/languages/owl2): Ontologies & description-logic reasoning.
- [SPARQL 1.1 (.rq, .sparql) [beta]](https://modelscript.org/languages/sparql): RDF knowledge-graph & digital-thread semantic queries.
- [STEP (ISO 10303) (.step) [beta]](https://modelscript.org/languages/step): B-Rep CAD assemblies & AP242 PMI.
- [QIF (ISO 23952) (.qif) [alpha]](https://modelscript.org/languages/qif): ASME Y14.5 / ISO 1101 GD&T metrology & SPC capability.
- [OpenSCAD (.scad) [beta]](https://modelscript.org/languages/scad): Parametric constructive solid geometry.
- [CFD (SU2 / OpenFOAM) (.su2) [alpha]](https://modelscript.org/languages/cfd): Computational fluid dynamics meshes.
- [FEA (CalculiX / Abaqus / NASTRAN) (.inp) [alpha]](https://modelscript.org/languages/fea): Finite-element structural analysis.

- [USACE HEC-2 (.hc2) [beta]](https://modelscript.org/languages/hec2): 1D Standard Step open-channel water surface profile solver.
- [SEG-Y (.sgy) [beta]](https://modelscript.org/languages/segy): Geophysical seismic EBCDIC/IBM-float codec, NMO & FFT solver.
- [FITS 4.0 (.fits) [beta]](https://modelscript.org/languages/fits): NASA/IAU Flexible Image Transport System HDU & WCS astrometry.
- [NetCDF Classic / CDL (.cdl) [beta]](https://modelscript.org/languages/netcdf): Unidata self-describing scientific arrays, CF linting & heatmap viewer.
- [NASA CDF (.skt) [beta]](https://modelscript.org/languages/nasa-cdf): Space-physics binary/skeleton telemetry, ISTP EPOCH & strip-chart viewer.
- [WMO GRIB Ed. 1 (.grb) [beta]](https://modelscript.org/languages/grib): Gridded binary meteorology, geostrophic wind & geographic heatmap viewer.
- [WMO BUFR (.bufr) [beta]](https://modelscript.org/languages/bufr): Table-driven synoptic weather bit-streams & upper-air sounding viewer.
- [USGS DEM (.dem) [beta]](https://modelscript.org/languages/usgs-dem): Digital Elevation Model slope/aspect, D8 flow & topographic map viewer.
- [NCSA HDF4 (.hdf) [beta]](https://modelscript.org/languages/hdf4): Hierarchical Data Format v4 Vgroup/SDS binary codec & heatmap viewer.
- [ARINC 429 (.a429) [beta]](https://modelscript.org/languages/arinc429): Commercial avionics 32-bit BNR/BCD bus codec & PFD instrument viewer.
- [NMEA 0183 (.nmea) [beta]](https://modelscript.org/languages/nmea0183): Marine/GPS ASCII telemetry, WGS-84 geodesy & track/skyplot viewer.
- [RINEX v2 (.obs) [beta]](https://modelscript.org/languages/rinex): GNSS OBS/NAV Keplerian ephemeris, 3D pseudorange fix & skyplot viewer.
- [IRIG 106 / TMATS (.tmats) [beta]](https://modelscript.org/languages/irig106): Flight-test PCM telemetry commutator & major/minor frame grid viewer.
- [ENDF-6 (.endf) [beta]](https://modelscript.org/languages/endf6): Evaluated nuclear cross-sections, Breit-Wigner resonances & log-log plot.
- [JCAMP-DX (.jdx) [beta]](https://modelscript.org/languages/jcamp-dx): IUPAC IR/NMR/MS ASDF/DIFDUP spectroscopy & interactive spectrum viewer.
- [IUCr Crystallographic CIF (.mcif) [beta]](https://modelscript.org/languages/iucr-cif): STAR/CIF crystal structures, powder XRD simulator & 3D lattice viewer.
- [3D Systems STL (.stl) [beta]](https://modelscript.org/languages/stl): ASCII/Binary STL meshes, mass/inertia, manifold lints & 3D shaded viewer.
- [Wavefront OBJ / MTL (.obj) [beta]](https://modelscript.org/languages/obj): 3D polygon meshes, MTL materials, CAD lowering & 3D shaded mesh viewer.
- [Intel HEX (.hex) [beta]](https://modelscript.org/languages/ihex): I8/I16/I32HEX ROM images, CRC-32, memory-map & hex/ASCII dump viewer.
- [Motorola S-Record (.srec) [beta]](https://modelscript.org/languages/srec): Motorola S0–S9 firmware images, memory-region & hex/ASCII dump viewer.
- [JEDEC JESD3 (.jed) [beta]](https://modelscript.org/languages/jedec): PAL/GAL fuse-maps, Boolean SOP extractor & fuse-matrix grid viewer.
- [ASN.1 (X.208 / X.680) (.asn1) [beta]](https://modelscript.org/languages/asn1): ASN.1 schemas, canonical BER/DER TLV codec & type-graph/TLV viewer.

## Engineering Industries (12 Sectors)
- [Industries Overview](https://modelscript.org/industries): Multi-domain solutions across 12 engineering sectors.
- [Aerospace & Aviation](https://modelscript.org/industries/aerospace): Flight dynamics, propulsion & mission telemetry (SysML v2 / KerML, ReqIF, NIST OSCAL 1.1).
- [Automotive & Mobility](https://modelscript.org/industries/automotive): AUTOSAR, powertrain & autonomous-driving scenarios (AUTOSAR Classic & Adaptive, ASAM OpenDRIVE, ASAM OpenSCENARIO).
- [Rail](https://modelscript.org/industries/rail): Vehicle dynamics, track geometry & EN 14363 (EN 14363, UIC 518, Kalker FASTSIM Contact).
- [Marine & Offshore](https://modelscript.org/industries/marine): Marine operations, risers & mooring (DNV-OS-E301 (Mooring), DNV-ST-0119 (Floating Wind), OC4 Semi-Submersible).
- [Power Systems & Grid](https://modelscript.org/industries/power-systems): EMT, power flow & grid-code compliance (IEEE 2800-2022 & NERC PRC-029-1, ENTSO-E RfG & IEEE 1547-2018, DIgSILENT PowerFactory (.dz / .pfd / .dsl)).
- [Oil, Gas & Subsurface](https://modelscript.org/industries/oil-gas): Flow assurance, pipelines & reservoirs (ISO 20765-1 (AGA-8), ISO 20765-2 (GERG-2008), OLGA (.opi / .key / .genkey) & PipelineStudio (.lps)).
- [Nuclear](https://modelscript.org/industries/nuclear): Reactor thermal-hydraulics & point kinetics (RELAP5-3D Input Decks (10 CFR 50 App. B), SysML v2 / KerML, ReqIF Traceability).
- [Buildings & Civil Infrastructure](https://modelscript.org/industries/buildings): Building energy, water, river hydraulics & groundwater (EnergyPlus IDF / epJSON (ASHRAE 90.1), EPANET INP, AWWA M36 & M31, EPA SWMM 5.x (Saint-Venant)).
- [Electronics, RF & Telecommunications](https://modelscript.org/industries/electronics): SPICE, compact models, IBIS, S-parameters, DWDM & 5G RAN (Accellera Verilog-A / Verilog-AMS LRM, IBIS & Touchstone 1.0 / 2.0, OpenROADM / GNPy DWDM & ITU-T G.8275.1 / G.8273.2).
- [Robotics & Industrial Automation](https://modelscript.org/industries/robotics): URDF kinematics, AutomationML, PLCs & mechanisms (IEC 61131-3 / PLCopen XML, IEC 62714 AutomationML (CAEX), URDF / Xacro).
- [Chemical & Process](https://modelscript.org/industries/process): Flowsheets, kinetics, geochemistry & molecular graphs (Aspen Plus / HYSYS (.bkp / .inp), gPROMS PML (Method of Lines), AMPL (.mod / .nl / .mps)).
- [Life Sciences, Healthcare & Medical](https://modelscript.org/industries/life-sciences): Systems biology, pharmacometrics, radiotherapy & surgical CAS (SBML L2/L3 & SED-ML, SBOL3 & GenBank, NONMEM NMTRAN & Monolix MLXTRAN).

## Reference & Tooling
- [Linter Rules Catalog](https://modelscript.org/reference/linter-rules): Directory of 2384 diagnostics across 148 engineering languages.
- [Export Formats](https://modelscript.org/reference/export-formats): Exporting to FMI 2.0/3.0 FMUs, SSP, STEP, CSV, and C code.
- [MCP & IDE Integration](https://modelscript.org/reference/mcp-and-ide): Model Context Protocol server for AI coding agents and VS Code integration.
- [Radiology & Surgical CAS](https://modelscript.org/reference/radiology-and-surgery): Radiation oncology, medical imaging, and computer-assisted surgery suite.
